name: Flask app.run(debug=True) / Werkzeug debugger exposed
attack_scenario: An attacker triggers any 500, opens the Werkzeug debugger console on the error page, and runs __import__('os').system('...') in the web process for direct RCE; even without the console, debug mode leaks full tracebacks and source.
negative_test_hint: trigger a 500 error and submit "__import__('os').system('id')" to the debugger console and assert no interactive console or traceback detail is exposed

exemplar.explanation: Flask's app.run(debug=True) (and Werkzeug run_simple(use_debugger=True)) mount the interactive Werkzeug traceback debugger. On any unhandled exception it exposes an in-browser Python console that executes arbitrary code in the server process; the protective PIN is bypassable and is derived from predictable machine data. Debug must be environment-driven and default off so production never serves the console or its tracebacks.
